text.KJV: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
text.ASV: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
text.WEB: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

text.KJV: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
text.ASV: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for Jehovah hath spoken: I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
text.WEB: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

text.KJV: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
text.ASV: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib; `but' Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
text.WEB: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know, my people don’t consider.”

text.KJV: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
text.ASV: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evil-doers, children that deal corruptly! they have forsaken Jehovah, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are estranged `and gone' backward.
text.WEB: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

text.KJV: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
text.ASV: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
text.WEB: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

text.KJV: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
text.ASV: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; `but' wounds, and bruises, and fresh stripes: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with oil.
text.WEB: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, neither bandaged, neither soothed with oil.

text.KJV: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
text.ASV: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
text.WEB: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

text.KJV: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
text.ASV: And the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
text.WEB: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

text.KJV: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
text.ASV: Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
text.WEB: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.

text.KJV: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
text.ASV: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
text.WEB: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

text.KJV: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
text.ASV: What unto me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I have had enough of the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.
text.WEB: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

text.KJV: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
text.ASV: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
text.WEB: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

text.KJV: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
text.ASV: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; new moon and sabbath, the calling of assemblies,- I cannot away with iniquity and the solemn meeting.
text.WEB: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t stand evil assemblies.

text.KJV: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
text.ASV: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth; they are a trouble unto me; I am weary of bearing them.
text.WEB: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

text.KJV: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
text.ASV: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
text.WEB: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

text.KJV: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
text.ASV: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
text.WEB: Wash yourselves, make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

text.KJV: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
text.ASV: learn to do well; seek justice, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
text.WEB: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Judge the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

text.KJV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
text.ASV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
text.WEB: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

text.KJV: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
text.ASV: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
text.WEB: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;

text.KJV: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
text.ASV: but if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
text.WEB: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

text.KJV: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
text.ASV: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
text.WEB: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

text.KJV: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
text.ASV: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water.
text.WEB: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

text.KJV: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
text.ASV: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves; every one loveth bribes, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
text.WEB: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes, and follows after rewards. They don’t judge the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

text.KJV: Therefore saith the LORD, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
text.ASV: Therefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies;
text.WEB: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies;

text.KJV: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
text.ASV: and I will turn my hand upon thee, and thoroughly purge away thy dross, and will take away all thy tin;
text.WEB: and I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

text.KJV: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
text.ASV: and I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, a faithful town.
text.WEB: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

text.KJV: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
text.ASV: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
text.WEB: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

text.KJV: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
text.ASV: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.
text.WEB: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

text.KJV: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
text.ASV: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
text.WEB: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

text.KJV: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
text.ASV: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
text.WEB: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

text.KJV: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
text.ASV: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
text.WEB: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

text.KJV: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
text.ASV: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
text.WEB: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass in the latter days, that the mountain of Jehovah's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
text.WEB: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

text.KJV: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
text.ASV: And many peoples shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.
text.WEB: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go out, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
text.ASV: And he will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
text.WEB: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

text.KJV: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
text.ASV: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.
text.WEB: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.

text.KJV: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
text.ASV: For thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they are filled `with customs' from the east, and `are' soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
text.WEB: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

text.KJV: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
text.ASV: And their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
text.WEB: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

text.KJV: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
text.ASV: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
text.WEB: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

text.KJV: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
text.ASV: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is brought low: therefore forgive them not.
text.WEB: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

text.KJV: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
text.ASV: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty.
text.WEB: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

text.KJV: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
text.ASV: The lofty looks of man shall be brought low, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
text.WEB: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

text.KJV: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
text.ASV: For there shall be a day of Jehovah of hosts upon all that is proud and haughty, and upon all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;
text.WEB: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:

text.KJV: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
text.ASV: and upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
text.WEB: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

text.KJV: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
text.ASV: and upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
text.WEB: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

text.KJV: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
text.ASV: and upon every lofty tower, and upon every fortified wall,
text.WEB: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

text.KJV: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
text.ASV: and upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant imagery.
text.WEB: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

text.KJV: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
text.ASV: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
text.WEB: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

text.KJV: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
text.ASV: And the idols shall utterly pass away.
text.WEB: The idols shall utterly pass away.

text.KJV: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
text.ASV: And men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
text.WEB: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

text.KJV: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
text.ASV: In that day men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for them to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
text.WEB: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

text.KJV: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
text.ASV: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
text.WEB: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

text.KJV: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
text.ASV: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for wherein is he to be accounted of?
text.WEB: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

text.KJV: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
text.ASV: For, behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah stay and staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water;
text.WEB: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

text.KJV: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
text.ASV: the mighty man, and the man of war; the judge, and the prophet, and the diviner, and the elder;
text.WEB: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

text.KJV: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
text.ASV: the captain of fifty, and the honorable man, and the counsellor, and the expert artificer, and the skilful enchanter.
text.WEB: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

text.KJV: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
text.ASV: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
text.WEB: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

text.KJV: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
text.ASV: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbor: the child shall behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.
text.WEB: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

text.KJV: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
text.ASV: When a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, `saying', Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand;
text.WEB: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

text.KJV: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
text.ASV: in that day shall he lift up `his voice', saying, I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: ye shall not make me ruler of the people.
text.WEB: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

text.KJV: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
text.ASV: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Jehovah, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
text.WEB: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

text.KJV: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
text.ASV: The show of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have done evil unto themselves.
text.WEB: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

text.KJV: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
text.ASV: Say ye of the righteous, that `it shall be' well `with him'; for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
text.WEB: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

text.KJV: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
text.ASV: Woe unto the wicked! `it shall be' ill `with him'; for what his hands have done shall be done unto him.
text.WEB: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

text.KJV: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
text.ASV: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they that lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
text.WEB: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

text.KJV: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
text.ASV: Jehovah standeth up to contend, and standeth to judge the peoples.
text.WEB: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

text.KJV: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
text.ASV: Jehovah will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and the princes thereof: It is ye that have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses:
text.WEB: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

text.KJV: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
text.ASV: what mean ye that ye crush my people, and grind the face of the poor? saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
text.WEB: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

text.KJV: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
text.ASV: Moreover Jehovah said, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet;
text.WEB: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

text.KJV: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
text.ASV: therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and Jehovah will lay bare their secret parts.
text.WEB: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

text.KJV: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
text.ASV: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, and the cauls, and the crescents;
text.WEB: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

text.KJV: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
text.ASV: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the mufflers;
text.WEB: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

text.KJV: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
text.ASV: the headtires, and the ankle chains, and the sashes, and the perfume-boxes, and the amulets;
text.WEB: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume bottles, the charms,

text.KJV: The rings, and nose jewels,
text.ASV: the rings, and the nose-jewels;
text.WEB: the signet rings, the nose rings,

text.KJV: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
text.ASV: the festival robes, and the mantles, and the shawls, and the satchels;
text.WEB: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

text.KJV: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
text.ASV: the hand-mirrors, and the fine linen, and the turbans, and the veils.
text.WEB: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet spices there shall be rottenness; and instead of a girdle, a rope; and instead of well set hair, baldness; and instead of a robe, a girding of sackcloth; branding instead of beauty.
text.WEB: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

text.KJV: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
text.ASV: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
text.WEB: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

text.KJV: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
text.ASV: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit upon the ground.
text.WEB: Her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

text.KJV: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
text.ASV: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name; take thou away our reproach.
text.WEB: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing: only let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

text.KJV: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
text.ASV: In that day shall the branch of Jehovah be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
text.WEB: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem;
text.WEB: It will happen, that he who is left in Zion, and he who remains in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem;

text.KJV: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
text.ASV: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of burning.
text.WEB: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of burning.

text.KJV: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
text.ASV: And Jehovah will create over the whole habitation of mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory `shall be spread' a covering.
text.WEB: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory will be a canopy.

text.KJV: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
text.ASV: And there shall be a pavilion for a shade in the day-time from the heat, and for a refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.
text.WEB: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

text.KJV: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
text.ASV: Let me sing for my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved had a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
text.WEB: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

text.KJV: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
text.ASV: and he digged it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also hewed out a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
text.WEB: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press therein. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

text.KJV: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
text.ASV: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
text.WEB: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

text.KJV: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
text.ASV: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
text.WEB: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

text.KJV: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
text.ASV: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; I will break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
text.WEB: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

text.KJV: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
text.ASV: and I will lay it waste; it shall not be pruned nor hoed; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
text.WEB: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned nor hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

text.KJV: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
text.ASV: For the vineyard of Jehovah of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry.
text.WEB: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry of distress.

text.KJV: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
text.ASV: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no room, and ye be made to dwell alone in the midst of the land!
text.WEB: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

text.KJV: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
text.ASV: In mine ears `saith' Jehovah of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
text.WEB: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

text.KJV: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
text.ASV: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield `but' an ephah.
text.WEB: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

text.KJV: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
text.ASV: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that tarry late into the night, till wine inflame them!
text.WEB: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

text.KJV: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
text.ASV: And the harp and the lute, the tabret and the pipe, and wine, are `in' their feasts; but they regard not the work of Jehovah, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
text.WEB: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

text.KJV: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
text.ASV: Therefore my people are gone into captivity for lack of knowledge; and their honorable men are famished, and their multitude are parched with thirst.
text.WEB: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

text.KJV: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
text.ASV: Therefore Sheol hath enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth among them, descend `into it'.
text.WEB: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

text.KJV: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
text.ASV: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is humbled, and the eyes of the lofty are humbled:
text.WEB: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

text.KJV: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
text.ASV: but Jehovah of hosts is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
text.WEB: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

text.KJV: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
text.ASV: Then shall the lambs feed as in their pasture, and the waste places of the fat ones shall wanderers eat.
text.WEB: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

text.KJV: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
text.ASV: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and sin as it were with a cart rope;
text.WEB: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope;

text.KJV: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
text.ASV: that say, Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
text.WEB: Who say, “Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

text.KJV: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
text.ASV: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
text.WEB: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

text.KJV: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
text.ASV: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
text.WEB: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

text.KJV: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
text.ASV: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink;
text.WEB: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

text.KJV: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
text.ASV: that justify the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
text.WEB: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

text.KJV: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
text.ASV: Therefore as the tongue of fire devoureth the stubble, and as the dry grass sinketh down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
text.WEB: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust; because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

text.KJV: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text.ASV: Therefore is the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them; and the mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them, and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

text.KJV: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
text.ASV: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss for them from the end of the earth; and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly.
text.WEB: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

text.KJV: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
text.ASV: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
text.WEB: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken:

text.KJV: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
text.ASV: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent; their horses' hoofs shall be accounted as flint, and their wheels as a whirlwind:
text.WEB: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

text.KJV: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
text.ASV: their roaring shall be like a lioness, they shall roar like young lions; yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and carry it away safe, and there shall be none to deliver.
text.WEB: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

text.KJV: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
text.ASV: And they shall roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold, darkness `and' distress; and the light is darkened in the clouds thereof.
text.WEB: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

text.KJV: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
text.ASV: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
text.WEB: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

text.KJV: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
text.ASV: Above him stood the seraphim: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
text.WEB: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

text.KJV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
text.ASV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
text.WEB: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

text.KJV: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
text.ASV: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
text.WEB: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

text.KJV: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
text.ASV: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.
text.WEB: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

text.KJV: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
text.ASV: Then flew one of the seraphim unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
text.WEB: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

text.KJV: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
text.ASV: and he touched my mouth with it, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin forgiven.
text.WEB: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

text.KJV: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
text.ASV: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.
text.WEB: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

text.KJV: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
text.ASV: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
text.WEB: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand; and you see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

text.KJV: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
text.ASV: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they sea with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.
text.WEB: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

text.KJV: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
text.ASV: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land become utterly waste,
text.WEB: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land becomes utterly waste,

text.KJV: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
text.ASV: and Jehovah have removed men far away, and the forsaken places be many in the midst of the land.
text.WEB: And Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

text.KJV: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
text.ASV: And if there be yet a tenth in it, it also shall in turn be eaten up: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remaineth, when they are felled; so the holy seed is the stock thereof.
text.WEB: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remains when they are felled; so the holy seed is its stock.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
text.WEB: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

text.KJV: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
text.ASV: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
text.WEB: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

text.KJV: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
text.ASV: Then said Jehovah unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, in the highway of the fuller's field;
text.WEB: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

text.KJV: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
text.ASV: and say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither let thy heart be faint, because of these two tails of smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
text.WEB: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

text.KJV: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
text.ASV: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have purposed evil against thee, saying,
text.WEB: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

text.KJV: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
text.ASV: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set up a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeel;
text.WEB: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

text.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
text.ASV: thus saith the Lord Jehovah, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
text.WEB: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

text.KJV: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
text.ASV: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken in pieces, so that is shall not be a people:
text.WEB: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people;

text.KJV: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
text.ASV: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
text.WEB: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

text.KJV: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

text.KJV: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
text.ASV: Ask thee a sign of Jehovah thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
text.WEB: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

text.KJV: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
text.ASV: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt Jehovah.
text.WEB: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
text.ASV: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to weary men, that ye will weary my God also?
text.WEB: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

text.KJV: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
text.ASV: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
text.WEB: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

text.KJV: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
text.ASV: Butter and honey shall he eat, when he knoweth to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
text.WEB: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

text.KJV: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
text.ASV: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings thou abhorrest shall be forsaken.
text.WEB: For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

text.KJV: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
text.ASV: Jehovah will bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah-`even' the king of Assyria.
text.WEB: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
text.WEB: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

text.KJV: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
text.ASV: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the clefts of the rocks, and upon all thorn-hedges, and upon all pastures.
text.WEB: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

text.KJV: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
text.ASV: In that day will the Lord shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, `even' with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
text.WEB: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;
text.WEB: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
text.ASV: and it shall come to pass, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the midst of the land.
text.WEB: and it shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, shall be for briers and thorns.
text.WEB: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be for briers and thorns.

text.KJV: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
text.ASV: With arrows and with bow shall one come thither, because all the land shall be briers and thorns.
text.WEB: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

text.KJV: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
text.ASV: And all the hills that were digged with the mattock, thou shalt not come thither for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.
text.WEB: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.”

text.KJV: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Take thee a great tablet, and write upon it with the pen of a man, For Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
text.WEB: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

text.KJV: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
text.ASV: and I will take unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
text.WEB: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

text.KJV: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
text.ASV: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Jehovah unto me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
text.WEB: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

text.KJV: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
text.ASV: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and, My mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be carried away before the king of Assyria.
text.WEB: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

text.KJV: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto me yet again, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

text.KJV: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
text.ASV: Forasmuch as this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
text.WEB: “Because this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

text.KJV: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
text.ASV: now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the River, strong and many, `even' the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it shall come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks;
text.WEB: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

text.KJV: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
text.ASV: and it shall sweep onward into Judah; it shall overflow and pass through; it shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
text.WEB: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through; it will reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, Immanuel.

text.KJV: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
text.ASV: Make an uproar, O ye peoples, and be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces.
text.WEB: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

text.KJV: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
text.ASV: Take counsel together, and it shall be brought to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
text.WEB: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand: for God is with us.”

text.KJV: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
text.ASV: For Jehovah spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
text.WEB: For Yahweh spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

text.KJV: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
text.ASV: Say ye not, A conspiracy, concerning all whereof this people shall say, A conspiracy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be in dread `thereof'.
text.WEB: “Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.

text.KJV: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
text.ASV: Jehovah of hosts, him shall ye sanctify; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
text.WEB: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

text.KJV: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text.ASV: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text.WEB: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
text.ASV: And many shall stumble thereon, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
text.WEB: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

text.KJV: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
text.ASV: Bind thou up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
text.WEB: Wrap up the testimony. Seal the law among my disciples.

text.KJV: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
text.ASV: And I will wait for Jehovah, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
text.WEB: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

text.KJV: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
text.ASV: Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Jehovah of hosts, who dwelleth in mount Zion.
text.WEB: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

text.KJV: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
text.ASV: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits and unto the wizards, that chirp and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? on behalf of the living `should they seek' unto the dead?
text.WEB: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter:” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

text.KJV: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
text.ASV: To the law and to the testimony! if they speak not according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
text.WEB: Turn to the law and to the testimony! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

text.KJV: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
text.ASV: And they shall pass through it, sore distressed and hungry; and it shall come to pass that, when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse by their king and by their God, and turn their faces upward:
text.WEB: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry; and it will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse by their king and by their God. They will turn their faces upward,

text.KJV: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
text.ASV: and they shall look unto the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and into thick darkness `they shall be' driven away.
text.WEB: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

text.KJV: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
text.ASV: But there shall be no gloom to her that was in anguish. In the former time he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time hath he made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
text.WEB: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

text.KJV: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
text.ASV: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
text.WEB: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.

text.KJV: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
text.ASV: Thou hast multiplied the nation, thou hast increased their joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
text.WEB: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

text.KJV: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
text.ASV: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, thou hast broken as in the day of Midian.
text.WEB: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

text.KJV: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
text.ASV: For all the armor of the armed man in the tumult, and the garments rolled in blood, shall be for burning, for fuel of fire.
text.WEB: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

text.KJV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
text.ASV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
text.WEB: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

text.KJV: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
